blocks.label: Opening
blocks.guidance: Acknowledge the recent event in one clean sentence as the reason for writing now.

blocks.label: Body
blocks.guidance: Tie one piece of the candidate's evidence to what the role actually needs. Lead with wanting to build inside a company rather than evaluate it from outside, and signal willingness to do the day-to-day.

blocks.label: Positioning
blocks.text: I am interested in supporting your team in {role_or_company}.

blocks.label: Close
blocks.text: Open to a short call to discuss options?

style.notes: Offer a read of their business as a hypothesis and an offer, not a lecture. Do not recite what the company does; assume they know their own product.
